# hosttracker_status_pages (Data Source)

Reads the account's status pages. A listing carries each page's identity and counters; read one page with the `hosttracker_status_page` data source for its settings and components.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hosttracker_status_pages" "all" {}

# The pages currently reporting trouble.
output "pages_with_open_incidents" {
  value = {
    for page in data.hosttracker_status_pages.all.status_pages :
    page.slug => page.unresolved_incidents if page.unresolved_incidents > 0
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_results` (Number) How many pages to collect across the cursor. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) The pages' ids, in the order the API returned them.
- `status_pages` (Attributes List) The account's status pages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_pages))

<a id="nestedatt--status_pages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status_pages`

Read-Only:

- `component_count` (Number) How many components the page publishes.
- `created` (Number) When the page was created, in Unix seconds.
- `has_password` (Boolean) Whether the page is behind a password.
- `id` (String) The page's id.
- `public_url` (String) Where the page is served from: `https://status.host-tracker.com/<slug>`.
- `slug` (String) The page's permanent public address.
- `title` (String) The heading the public page carries.
- `unresolved_incidents` (Number) How many of the page's declared incidents are still open.
